record.scope: BRAIXEN, DELPHOX and FENNEKIN (the queued units; the only units declaring MYSTICAL_FIRE in the catalog).
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage (20 / 40 / 80 / 160 raw by caster stars) FIRST, then addAbilityPower(-15 / -20 / -25 / -50, caster, apBoost 1, crit) on the same target. For an ordinary target the request is scaled by the CASTER's AP and the cast crit before the helpers (1 star, caster AP 100 with a crit at critPower 2: round(-15 x 2 x 2) = -60 stored from AP 0), a Twist Band holder gains it instead and AP floors at -100. addAbilityPower checks the Nullify Bandanna FIRST: such a target skips the AP scaling and loses round(0.2 x the RAW request) = -3 ATK through addAttack(apBoost 0, crit false) (Nullify + Twist Band gains 3; ATK floors at 1). The AP-change call still happens when the damage returned 0 (protect, magicBounce) or killed the target.

effects.scaling: requested amount: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true); x2 if DOUBLE_DAMAGE (consumed); crit multiplier only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault false: needs ABILITY_CRIT)
effects.resolution: applied amount: then the target's SPE_DEF division (damage / (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF)) and later handleDamage modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce can reflect it); the returned results are ignored by this ability (section J1)

effects.target: the damaged target (same entity as the hit)

declaredRaw.note: requested AP loss magnitudes as written in the source table; the code passes them negated, i.e. -15 / -20 / -25 / -50 (fallback -50)

effects.scaling: for an ordinary target (no Nullify Bandanna): round(value x (1 + 1 x casterAP/100) x critPower-if-crit), apBoost 1 is passed, so a caster with more AP removes more AP and a crit multiplies it; this scaling is NOT applied on the Nullify path (below)
effects.resolution: applied amount: the Nullify check comes FIRST: if the target holds NULLIFY_BANDANNA the AP request is not scaled at all and its ATK changes instead by round(0.2 x the RAW negative request) (-3 / -4 / -5 / -10) through addAttack(.., caster, apBoost 0, crit false), so the caster's AP and crit do not scale it (executed: caster AP 100 with a crit still gives -3 ATK, ATK 20 -> 17); otherwise Big Eater Belt does not apply (the value is negative and the caster is an enemy), Twist Band on the target flips the negative value to positive, so the target GAINS that much AP (also in the nullify branch through addAttack); then target.ap = max(-100, ap + value); not permanent (the board unit is unchanged); the change happens whether or not the damage hit was blocked

starBehavior.note: both tables are indexed by the casting entity's stars (pokemon.stars - 1); the 4-star entries (160 damage, -50 AP) and the fallbacks are declared in the tables but unused by the bound baseline classes (bare stars 2, 3, 1). maxPP is 80 and range 2 for all three.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond the target being within the caster's range (2).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No state is kept by the ability; each cast removes AP again and the target's AP can keep falling to the floor of -100. No modes.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested damage 20 / 40 / 80 (FENNEKIN / BRAIXEN / DELPHOX); applied = x(1 + AP/100) [x2 DOUBLE_DAMAGE] [x crit], then the SPE_DEF division and later modifiers (takenDamage unused). Requested AP change -15 / -20 / -25; applied = round(value x (1 + casterAP/100) x crit factor), then Twist Band may flip its sign on the target, Nullify Bandanna converts it into a 20% ATK change, and the target's AP is floored at -100.
